observed_failure: Actual build-controller-manifest invocation rejected IMPORT_OUTSIDE_FIXED_RUNTIME before wx manifest creation.
cause: The fixed Python executable uses forward slash literals; path.dirname preserved them, while Python-imported absolute paths normalized to backslashes. Previous direct string-prefix comparison used different separator representations.
change: Resolve both paths and use native path.relative; require empty relative path or a non-absolute descendant without a parent-traversal prefix. Fixed allowed roots are unchanged.

targeted_test.covers: Mixed Windows separators/case accepted; same root accepted; sibling prefix, parent traversal and other drive rejected.
